title: Make phase-trace test flush completion explicit
outcome: Make phase-trace test flush completion explicit
acceptance: Phase-trace tests report a flush timeout or missing acknowledgement explicitly instead of proceeding to line-count or stage assertions with a possibly incomplete capture; their ordering and stage assertions remain intact.

completion.summary: Every phase-trace test flush wait now uses assert_flushed, which panics on a flush timeout or missing acknowledgement before any line-count or stage assertion; ordering and stage assertions unchanged.
